SubLayerProcessing.SQLScript: SELECT alertGroupID, alertGroupCode, alertGroupDescription, displayText, sortOrder, isActive, hash(concat(coalesce(cast(alertGroupID as string), ''), '|', coalesce(alertGroupCode, ''), '|', coalesce(alertGroupDescription, ''), '|', coalesce(displayText, ''), '|', coalesce(cast(sortOrder as string), ''), '|', coalesce(cast(isActive as string), 'false'))) AS hashKey FROM (SELECT AlertGroupID AS alertGroupID, AlertGroupCode AS alertGroupCode, AlertGroupDescription AS alertGroupDescription, DisplayText AS displayText, SortOrder AS sortOrder, Active AS isActive FROM AlertGroup) a
SubLayerProcessing.MergeScript: MERGE INTO claimspan.silver.silver_alertgroup t USING (SELECT * FROM tempSQLScript) s ON s.alertGroupID = t.alertGroupID WHEN MATCHED AND t.hashKey <> s.hashKey THEN UPDATE SET t.alertGroupID = s.alertGroupID, t.alertGroupCode = s.alertGroupCode, t.alertGroupDescription = s.alertGroupDescription, t.displayText = s.displayText, t.sortOrder = s.sortOrder, t.isActive = s.isActive, t.hashKey = s.hashKey WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (alertGroupID, alertGroupCode, alertGroupDescription, displayText, sortOrder, isActive, hashKey) VALUES (s.alertGroupID, s.alertGroupCode, s.alertGroupDescription, s.displayText, s.sortOrder, s.isActive, s.hashKey)
